title: Formalization Plan

canonical_node.axiom: Formalization must proceed incrementally, separating crisp toy claims from speculative physics, and maintaining an audit trail of assumptions and proof status.
definitions: C0, C1: coupling states in the toy structural core.
Transition relation: a defined relation from C0 to C1.
Irreversibility: relative to the transition relation.
Q = 0 gate: multiplicative gate in the toy master equation.
Stages: localization, stabilization, release, confirmation, redistribution.
Candidate isomorphism: a mapping between physics-side and theology-side operation sequences preserving order and composition.
LawIso: minimal isomorphism that proved binary abstraction but admitted a coin false positive.
RichLawIso: enriched isomorphism adding role and transition preservation, blocking natural coin false positive but still admitting deliberately relabeled coin.
BridgeMatrix: encodes ten canonical factor rows, validates physical/spiritual signatures, rejects targeted semantic swaps, rechecks full-product zero collapse.
Claim matrix: public audit trail of claims and their status.
derivation: Phase 1 formalizes only crisp claims: coupling states, transition, irreversibility, Q=0 gate.
Phase 2 defines stages and legal transitions, proving basic reachability and non-reversal facts.
Phase 3 tests candidate isomorphism language: define physics-side and theology-side sequences, define mapping, prove or refute preservation of order and composition.

LawIso proved binary abstraction but admitted a coin false positive; RichLawIso added role and transition preservation, blocking natural coin false positive but still admitting deliberately relabeled coin.
Next task: semantic grounding connecting formal roles/transitions to source-justified claims.
BridgeMatrix encodes ten canonical factor rows, validates signatures, rejects semantic swaps, rechecks full-product zero collapse.
Phase 4: separate speculative assumptions from proved toy claims in namespace/files; maintain claim matrix.
Phase 5: define test targets without claiming Lean can test history; separate historical datasets from formal definitions; track confirmation/disconfirmation/non-testability.
canonical_node.action: Implement the formalization plan in phases, maintaining separation of speculative assumptions and proved claims, and updating the claim matrix as the audit trail.
boundary: Does not claim physics is proved.
Does not claim Lean can test history.
Does not claim full isomorphism is established; composition preservation is open.
Does not claim RichLawIso is fully semantically grounded; deliberately relabeled coin still admitted.
Does not claim BridgeMatrix is source-grounded; remaining burden is source-grounding and richer equation-level signatures.
test: Check that Phase 1 formalizes only crisp claims.
Check that Phase 2 defines stages and legal transitions, and proves reachability/non-reversal.
Check that Phase 3 defines mapping and attempts proof/refutation of order and composition preservation.
Check that RichLawIso blocks natural coin false positive but admits deliberately relabeled coin.
Check that BridgeMatrix encodes ten canonical factor rows and rejects targeted semantic swaps.
Check that Phase 4 separates speculative assumptions from proved claims in namespace/files.
Check that Phase 5 defines test targets without claiming historical testability.

dg1_dependencies: Toy structural core definitions (C0, C1, transition, irreversibility, Q=0 gate).
BridgeMatrix encoding of ten canonical factor rows.
dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides a structured plan for incremental formalization, separating crisp claims from speculative physics, and establishing an audit trail via claim matrix.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the existing toy formalizations (LawIso, RichLawIso, BridgeMatrix) and their known limitations.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: Without this plan, formalization efforts may conflate speculative assumptions with proved claims, undermining auditability and trust.
dg5_translation_registers: Stages -> localization, stabilization, release, confirmation, redistribution
Candidate isomorphism -> mapping preserving order and composition
LawIso -> minimal isomorphism with coin false positive
RichLawIso -> enriched isomorphism with role/transition preservation
BridgeMatrix -> ten canonical factor rows with signatures

classification.recommended_atom_action: track as planning artifact; do not treat as proof of physics

overstatement_risks: May be mistaken for a proof of physics if not clearly marked as a plan.
May overstate the status of LawIso or RichLawIso if not noting admitted false positives.
May overstate BridgeMatrix completeness if not noting source-grounding burden.
kill_conditions: If the plan claims physics is proved.
If the plan claims Lean can test history.
If the plan claims full isomorphism is established when composition preservation is open.
risk.lean_target: Formalize the toy structural core and stage machine in Lean, with clear separation of axioms and theorems.

plain_summary: This document outlines a phased plan for formalizing claims, separating crisp toy results from speculative physics, and maintaining an audit trail. It does not establish any physics proofs; it is a planning artifact.
